tools.name: pricing_info
tools.description: Free — list every paid tool in the 'company-intel' bundle with its price, payTo address and network. Call this first if you don't have a wallet ready yet.

tools.name: company-hiring-radar
tools.description: Pull every open role a company is hiring for from its public job board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) and turn it into a buying/expansion signal: role count, which functions are growing (sales, engineering, marketing), remote share and what's new. No login, no scraping, no proxies. — $0.01/call, x402 (U

tools.name: company-lookup
tools.description: Turn a domain or company name into one unified company card: website tech stack (CMS, ecommerce, key tech) for domains, plus a live GLEIF registry match (legal name, jurisdiction, status, LEI). Keyless, no login — built for AI agents and sales. — $0.01/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: company-registry-enricher
tools.description: Turn a company name, LEI or UK company number into an official registry card: legal name, status, jurisdiction, registered address and LEI via GLEIF (free, no key). Optionally add UK directors and SIC codes with your own Companies House API key. — $0.01/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: competitor-change-rollup
tools.description: One card per competitor summarising what changed across several signals in the past week. Partial cards are marked partial and list which signals are missing. — $0.08/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: counterparty-risk-rollup
tools.description: Screen a counterparty in one call: OFAC + EU sanctions match, GLEIF legal-entity registry, litigation history (US/UK/PL) and a hiring signal from public ATS boards, combined into one row per company with a documented risk score. Keyless sources only. — $0.03/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: email-verifier
tools.description: Checks email addresses: syntax, domain, and whether the domain publishes mail exchangers. Where mailbox-level existence cannot be established, the field is null rather than a guess. — $0.02/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: funding-alert
tools.description: Watches funding announcements for a saved filter and returns only what changed since the previous check. The first run on a new filter creates the baseline and says so. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: funding-round-tracker
tools.description: Track recent SEC Form D filings by company name or sector keyword — the notice a company files when it raises private capital. Official SEC EDGAR full-text search, free, no API key or login. Get company, filing date and a direct document URL for every match. — $0.02/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: hiring-trend-index
tools.description: A cross-section of hiring demand by role and geography, assembled from several job sources in one call. Partial results are marked partial and list what is missing. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: intent-signal-aggregator
tools.description: Is this company in-market right now? Combines public hiring activity (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby) and recent news (funding, launches, partnerships) into one intent score per company. No login, no API keys, no proxies. — $0.01/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: layoff-tracker
tools.description: Track recent tech layoffs by company name or sector (e.g. "fintech", "AI") straight from Google News — a demand and recruiting signal. No login, no scraping, no proxies. Returns matched headlines, mention count and a one-line summary per query. — $0.01/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: lead-list-qualifier
tools.description: Scores domains for buying readiness from several of our own signal sources in one call. Identity confidence is reported honestly as guessed when no override is supplied. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: litigation-check
tools.description: Screen a company for litigation history across US federal dockets (CourtListener), UK case law and Polish court judgments. Keyless, one row per company x jurisdiction, with the true case count and links to the source records. — $0.03/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: new-company-detector
tools.description: Find newly-incorporated UK companies matching a keyword, read from Companies House's public advanced-search results (active companies incorporated in the last ~60 days by default). No API key, no login, no proxies. — $0.02/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: patent-monitor
tools.description: Watch keywords or technologies for newly granted US patents. Bring your own free PatentsView API key — get patent id, title, grant date, assignee and a direct Google Patents link for every match, sorted by most recent. Official PatentsView Search API (USPTO-backed). — $0.02/call, x402 (USDC on base)

tools.name: sanctions-screening
tools.description: Screen names against the live OFAC SDN and EU consolidated sanctions lists. Keyless, no login — flags potential hits with a match score so you can review before onboarding a client or counterparty. — $0.01/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: sanctions-update-alert
tools.description: Re-screens a saved watchlist against sanctions lists and returns only the entries whose status changed since the previous check. The first run creates the baseline and says so. — $0.05/call, x402 (USDC on base).

tools.name: website-contact-extractor
tools.description: Extract public contacts a company posted on its own site: email, phone, social links — with an honesty check that flags third-party/placeholder addresses instead of selling them as the company's own. — $0.02/call, x402 (USDC on base).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "company-intel" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: funding-round-tracker, website-contact-extractor · Private data: pricing_info, company-registry-enricher, funding-round-tracker, intent-signal-aggregator, litigation-check, new-company-detector, patent-monitor, website-contact-extractor · Public sink: company-hiring-radar, email-verifier, website-contact-extractor · Destructive: funding-alert, sanctions-update-alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: funding-round-tracker, website-contact-extractor · Private data: pricing_info, company-registry-enricher, funding-round-tracker, intent-signal-aggregator, litigation-check, new-company-detector, patent-monitor, website-contact-extractor · Public sink: company-hiring-radar, email-verifier, website-contact-extractor · Destructive: funding-alert, sanctions-update-alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
